rows.event: event1, event2, event3, event5, event6, event7

rows.description: Referral source indicating discovery via AI-powered/agentic search or LLM crawler (GEO/LLMO). Captured from referrer/UA heuristics.
Flag indicating page compliance with Heritage SG brand guidelines (and presence of standard government disclaimer, BRD 106).
Live per-venue crowd density indicator level derived from real-time AA session data (low / medium / high).
firstFestivalYear content field from AEMaaCS model — indicates debut year of the programme / installation.
Template/page type (home, listing, detail, policy, map, trails). Distinguishes Privacy, Terms, Cookie Policy views.
Unique ID of the festival programme or installation in context. Also used for QR check-in installation ID.
Mirror of the Programme / Installation Name eVar for pathing across festival content items.
Display title of the programme or installation being viewed/listed.
Flag indicating presence of Schema.org JSON-LD structured data / indexability on the page (BRD 801–803).
Scheduled date and time slot of the programme / installation shown in listings and detail pages.
State of optional unlocked content on a programme detail page (locked / unlocked-via-QR / none). Only visible to scanned-in visitors.
Venue associated with the programme / installation within the Bras Basah–Bugis precinct.
Rendered viewport / responsive delivery mode (desktop / mobile) per approved wireframes.
Type of inline optimisation suggestion surfaced for itinerary conflicts/inefficiencies (dismissible, non-blocking).
Active Adobe Target personalisation use case in context (your-picks / trending-circle / returning-banner / last-chance).
Context of an affinity-matched recommendation shown or clicked (feed position, programme recommended).
Unique ID of the trail or custom itinerary (used for save/follow, sharing, adoption and Community Picks).
Origin of the itinerary in context (self-created / shared-view / one-tap-adopted / community-pick).
Mirror of the Trail Name eVar for pathing through curated and custom trail flows.
File name of the downloaded document.
File format of the downloaded document.
Display name of the downloaded document.
Visitor's location-permission state (granted / denied) governing proximity sorting and default listing behaviour.
The moment/context that triggered registration (QR first scan, itinerary adoption, save trail, manual). Drives funnel-by-trigger reporting.
Derived student-cohort flag from geo cluster, visit timing and referral source. Not stored as permanent PII; refreshed annually.
Client-side derived zone label passed to Adobe Target. Raw GPS never stored server-side (PDPA).
Consent action captured for the consent log (grant / withdraw) by tier, effective immediately via self-service settings.
Cookie consent categories accepted (Strictly Necessary / Analytics & Performance / Personalisation & Targeting).
Three-tier consent model selection captured at registration (Tier 0 Functional / Tier 1 Festival Marketing / Tier 2 Year-Round NHB).
Visitor intent classified in a Brand Concierge interaction (programme discovery / trail recommendation / venue info / general info).
Outcome of a Brand Concierge interaction (answered / escalated / failed) for engagement and escalation-rate reporting.
Method used for itinerary sharing via native device share (no social OAuth). Captures channel chosen by OS share sheet.
External campaign tracking code (utm_campaign / cid) — Adobe s.campaign.
Context of the Klook ticketing call-to-action click directing visitors off-site (programme/installation referenced).
Industry vertical classification for the project.
Unique identifier for the current project instance.
Human-readable name of the current project.
Time in milliseconds taken to complete the step.
ISO timestamp when the step was completed.
ISO timestamp when the step was started.
Unique identifier of the completed journey step.
Human-readable name of the completed journey step.
Ordinal position of the step within the project journey.
Experience Cloud ID for the visitor.
[Hashed — PII] SHA-256 hashed registered visitor ID for CRM/AEP profile stitching. Never store raw email.
Visitor registration/authentication state. Supports email-registration and optional-registration tracking.
Form or Chat interface the interaction used.
Visible text label of the interaction element.
Name of the curated self-guided trail being presented, selected or followed.
Generic interaction descriptor for key user interactions (CTA click, expand, filter, share, etc.).
Context of interactive precinct map interactions (pin click, zoom, listing open) on the MapBox map.
Business unit / property identifier. Baseline global dimension for cross-property roll-up.
Environment flag (production / staging / dev). Backs the Production Data Only segment.
Friendly page name for all instrumented pages across the SNF site.
Numeric page load time in milliseconds. Paired with Page Load Time Instances to build the Avg Page Load Time calculated metric.
Hostname of the server that served the page.
Top-level site section for content grouping and navigation reporting.
Full page URL of the current page. Baseline global dimension on every hit.
HTTP referrer URL for the page view.
